name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 130 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 130 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli forces have intensified a crackdown in Hebron, displacing thousands and prompting UN warnings of ethnic cleansing, while IDF raids have expelled farmers and settlers have attacked olive pickers. The Israeli election remains deadlocked, with Netanyahu losing a majority and exit polls showing a narrow edge for the opposition amid record turnout. Gaza’s women filmmakers have launched a new academy to turn pain into cinema. A Hebron groom was caught in a military lockdown. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker har skjerpet nedslaget i Hebron, noe som har fordrevet tusenvis og fått FN til å advare om etnisk rensing, mens IDF-raid har kastet bønder på flukt og bosettere har angrepet olivenplukkere. Det israelske valget er fortsatt fastlåst, med Netanyahu som mister flertall og avgangsmeningsmålinger som viser en liten fordel for opposisjonen i en valgturnering med rekorddeltakelse. Gazas kvinnelige filmregissører har startet et nytt akademi for å omforme smerte til film. En brudgom fra Hebron ble fanget i en militær nedstengning. Konflikten førte til 21 440 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
